♡ ✞ ❁ Sovereign care for women & mothers

Wildbloom Holistic Care offers nurturing, restorative experiences created especially for women and mothers, weaving together holistic bodywork, botanical skincare, feminine wellness, energy work and supportive practices.

Jess brings a gentle, intuitive approach to her work, creating space for women to slow down, reconnect with their bodies and receive deeply restorative care.

🌸 FACIAL & SKIN RITUALS

The Botanical Refresh Facial
45 minutes | $145
A revitalising botanical facial incorporating focused lymphatic facial massage and a hydrating botanical mask.

The Skin & Spirit Infusion
1 hour | $165
Where skincare meets energy work. Includes botanical cleansing, facial Gua Sha drainage and chakra balancing.

The Sculpt, Cup & Gua Sha Ritual
1 hour 15 minutes | $230
An advanced, bespoke facial featuring deep manual facial sculpting, followed by your choice of targeted facial cupping or cooling Gua Sha drainage.
Finished with a Botanical Finishing Infusion featuring herbal serums, plant-based oils and a cold-pressed floral mist.

🌿 BODYWORK & MASSAGE RITUALS

Aromatherapy Massage — Rhythmic Reset
1 hour | $170
A grounding, sensory massage tailored to your needs, using bespoke essential-oil blends to encourage relaxation, flow and inner calm.

The Grounded Sole Reflexology Ritual
1 hour | $150
Foot reflexology combined with rhythmic, restorative massage of the feet and calves.

The Alchemical Body & Face Sculpt
1 hour 45 minutes | $285
Wildbloom's most comprehensive ritual.
Includes:
• 60 minutes full-body aromatherapy massage
• 45 minutes intensive facial sculpting
• Lymphatic drainage
• Custom botanical tools
The Grounded Soul Balance
1 hour 15 minutes | $200
A total recalibration combining:
• 45 minutes Grounded Sole Reflexology of the feet and calves
• 30 minutes immersive chakra balancing

🤰 MOTHERHOOD & FEMININE WISDOM

Pregnancy or Postpartum Massage
1 hour | $160
Specialised, nurturing massage tailored to support the changing needs of your body during pregnancy or postpartum.

The Mother’s Blessing — Pregnancy
2 hours | $255
A sacred space for honouring the transition into motherhood.
Includes:
• Aromatic herbal foot soak
• Restorative pregnancy massage
• Belly blessing
• Reiki

The Mother’s Warming — Postpartum
2 hours | $255
A traditional-inspired postpartum warming ritual.
Includes:
• Moxa womb care
• Abdominal massage
• Reiki
• Traditional belly wrapping

The Womb Wisdom Ritual
1 hour 45 minutes | $295
A feminine wellness ritual combining professional womb massage with a personalised herbal Yoni Steam experience.

Sacred Yoni Steaming Journey
1 hour 15 minutes | $210
A meditative feminine wellness experience incorporating:
• Personalised herbal Yoni Steam
• Guided breathwork
• Tea ceremony
• Intuitive tarot guidance

✨ ENERGETIC & SUPPORTIVE GUIDANCE

Holistic Wellness Discovery Consultation
45 minutes | $45
Not sure which experience is right for you?
A supportive consultation to discuss your current needs and intentions and explore a tailored pathway forward.
Together, you can co-create a session plan incorporating options such as restorative energetic bodywork, Reiki or somatic support.

Mindful Connection — Support Session
1 hour 30 minutes | $30
A dedicated space for gentle presence, deep listening and somatic support.

As a counselling student, Jess offers a compassionate, non-judgemental space where you can talk, cry, be heard or simply sit in quiet reflection.

Sessions may incorporate simple grounding practices such as mindful breathing and meditation.

Reiki & Sound Healing
1 hour | $140
An intuitive energetic experience combining Reiki and sacred sound practices, designed to support relaxation, calm and a sense of energetic balance.

🌹 MEET JESS
Wildbloom Holistic Care
Jess creates nurturing spaces for women and mothers through different seasons of life, with a focus on restorative bodywork, feminine wellness, holistic beauty, energetic care and supportive connection.
Her offerings are designed to provide women with space to slow down, receive, reconnect with themselves and feel held through life's transitions.
